name: list_products
description: List all products currently held in inventory, including quantity on hand, warehouse location, reorder point, category and unit price. Use this when the user asks a broad question about stock or inventory levels.

category.description: Optional category filter, for example 'Electrical' or 'Fasteners'.

name: get_product
description: Retrieve a single product from inventory by its product identifier.

name: check_reorder
description: Return every product whose on-hand quantity has fallen to or below its reorder point. Use this to answer questions about what needs restocking.
